mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO agency for my cosmetic surgery practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO agency, look for one with a proven track record in the medical or cosmetic surgery field, as they'll understand the specific nuances and ethical considerations. Inquire about their methodology for identifying relevant patient questions, their content creation process, and their expertise in structured data (schema markup). Ask for case studies showing how they've successfully achieved featured snippets and direct answers for clients. Ensure they provide clear reporting on AEO-specific metrics, not just traditional SEO metrics. A good agency will also emphasize continuous optimization and adaptation to evolving search engine algorithms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO agency with medical field experience, proven success in achieving featured snippets, expertise in structured data, and clear reporting on AEO-specific metrics.
